bounds: The phrase set finds a test a session ANNOTATED after re-aiming it. An instance nobody annotated is invisible here, so these counts BOUND the class rather than counting it (residue 2026-09-23-tests-that-assert-the-defect-they-were-written-for).

mechanisms.expected-value: The assertion's expected value was the defect's own output, so the fix had to change the expectation.
mechanisms.fixture-shape: The fixture's input or environment differed from production's, so the assertion never met the contract it names.
mechanisms.predicate-strength: The predicate was strictly weaker than the contract, or incidental to it, so the defect satisfied it.
